import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final char ENDLINE_CHAR = '\n';
    static final long INF_VAL = 0x3f3f3f3f;
    static final long INFLL_VAL = 0x3f3f3f3f3f3f3f3fL;
    static final long MODULO = 1000000007L;
    static final double TINY = 1e-10;

    static final int NUM_STEPS = 99;
    static final int NUM_COST_STEPS = 15;

    static class NetworkFlow {
        static final int MAX_VERTICES = 50 * NUM_STEPS + 2;
        static final int MAX_ARCS = 2 * MAX_VERTICES * NUM_COST_STEPS + MAX_VERTICES + 7;

        int[] parent = new int[MAX_VERTICES];
        int[] head = new int[MAX_VERTICES];
        int[] next_arc = new int[2 * MAX_ARCS];
        int[] to_node = new int[2 * MAX_ARCS];
        int num_edges;
        long[] flow = new long[2 * MAX_ARCS];
        long[] capacity = new long[2 * MAX_ARCS];
        long[] weight = new long[2 * MAX_ARCS];
        boolean[] visited = new boolean[MAX_VERTICES];
        int[] que = new int[MAX_VERTICES];
        int[] in_que = new int[MAX_VERTICES];
        long[] dist = new long[MAX_VERTICES];
        long[] potential = new long[MAX_VERTICES];

        void reset() {
            num_edges = 0;
            Arrays.fill(head, -1);
            Arrays.fill(flow, 0);
        }

        void connect(int u, int v, long cap, long w) {
            next_arc[num_edges] = head[to_node[num_edges] = u];
            head[to_node[num_edges]] = num_edges;
            capacity[num_edges] = cap;
            weight[num_edges] = w;
            ++num_edges;

            next_arc[num_edges] = head[to_node[num_edges] = v];
            head[to_node[num_edges]] = num_edges;
            capacity[num_edges] = 0;
            weight[num_edges] = -w;
            ++num_edges;
        }

        void initialize_potentials(int n) {
            Arrays.fill(potential, 0);
            for (int k = 1; k < n; ++k) {
                for (int e = 0; e < num_edges; ++e) {
                    if (capacity[e] > 0) {
                        potential[to_node[e ^ 1]] = Math.min(potential[to_node[e ^ 1]], potential[to_node[e]] + weight[e]);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        long update(int s, int t, long[] total_weight, int n) {
            Arrays.fill(visited, false);
            Arrays.fill(dist, INF_VAL);
            dist[s] = 0;
            Arrays.fill(in_que, -1);

            int qhead = 0, qtail = 0;
            in_que[que[qtail++] = s] = qtail - 1;

            while (qhead < qtail) {
                int u = que[qhead++];
                in_que[u] = -1;

                for (int e = head[u]; e != -1; e = next_arc[e]) {
                    int v = to_node[e ^ 1];
                    if (flow[e] < capacity[e] && dist[v] > dist[u] + potential[u] - potential[v] + weight[e]) {
                        dist[v] = dist[u] + potential[u] - potential[v] + weight[e];
                        parent[v] = e;
                        if (in_que[v] == -1) {
                            in_que[que[qtail] = v] = qtail;
                            ++qtail;
                        }
                        for (int idx = in_que[v], prnt = (idx - 1) / 2;
                             idx > 0 && dist[que[idx]] < dist[que[prnt]];
                             idx = prnt, prnt = (idx - 1) / 2) {
                            int tempQue = que[idx];
                            que[idx] = que[prnt];
                            que[prnt] = tempQue;
                            int tempInQue = in_que[que[idx]];
                            in_que[que[idx]] = in_que[que[prnt]];
                            in_que[que[prnt]] = tempInQue;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            if (dist[t] >= INF_VAL) return 0;

            long df = INFLL_VAL;
            for (int e, node = t; node != s; node = to_node[e]) {
                e = parent[node];
                df = Math.min(df, capacity[e] - flow[e]);
            }

            for (int e, node = t; node != s; node = to_node[e]) {
                e = parent[node];
                flow[e] += df;
                flow[e ^ 1] -= df;
                total_weight[0] += df * weight[e];
            }

            for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
                potential[i] = Math.min(INF_VAL, dist[i] + potential[i]);
            }

            return df;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        int n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int m = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int k = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int c = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int d = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        final int SRC = 0;
        final int DST = n * NUM_STEPS + 1;
        NetworkFlow net = new NetworkFlow();
        net.reset();

        st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        for (int i = 0; i < k; ++i) {
            int a = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            net.connect(SRC, a, 1, 0);
        }

        for (int step = 0; step < NUM_STEPS; ++step) {
            net.connect(1 + step * n, DST, INFLL_VAL, 0);
            if (step > 0) {
                for (int node = 1; node <= n; ++node) {
                    net.connect(node + (step - 1) * n, node + step * n, INFLL_VAL, c);
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < m; ++i) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            int a = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            int b = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            for (int lvl = 0; lvl < NUM_COST_STEPS; ++lvl) {
                int edge_weight = (lvl + 1) * (lvl + 1) - lvl * lvl;
                for (int step = 1; step < NUM_STEPS; ++step) {
                    net.connect(a + (step - 1) * n, b + step * n, 1, edge_weight * d + c);
                    net.connect(b + (step - 1) * n, a + step * n, 1, edge_weight * d + c);
                }
            }
        }

        net.initialize_potentials(NetworkFlow.MAX_VERTICES);
        long[] cost_sum = new long[1];
        long flow_sum = 0;
        while (true) {
            long delta = net.update(SRC, DST, cost_sum, NetworkFlow.MAX_VERTICES);
            if (delta == 0) break;
            flow_sum += delta;
        }

        if (flow_sum != k) {
            throw new AssertionError("Flow sum does not equal k");
        }
        System.out.println(cost_sum[0]);
    }
}
